type.Description: Type of channel; MUST use the channel types listed below. Note that the type MUST be in upper-case.

electrode_name.Description: Name of the electrode contact point. The value MUST match a name entry in the corresponding *_electrodes.tsv file, linking this channel to its associated electrode contact point. For channels not associated with an electrode, use n/a.

units.Description: Physical unit of the value represented in this channel, for example, V for Volt, or fT/cm for femto Tesla per centimeter (see Units).
